# YouInc

> YouInc turns your accounts into a live double-entry ledger, then renders it as an executive dashboard — net worth, cashflow, runway, income, expenses, and exceptions.

YouInc is an open-source, self-hosted personal finance ledger built in New Zealand. You run your own instance: bank sync goes read-only through your own Akahu connection, manual accounts cover anything a bank feed can't see, and the full ledger exports as portable, hledger-compatible plain-text journals. There is no hosted service, no account to create, and nothing to buy — youinc.net publishes a sample-data demo and the documentation, and the software itself lives on GitHub.

## Product

- [Home](https://youinc.net/): Run yourself like a company — the YouInc landing page.
- [Live demo](https://youinc.net/demo): The real dashboard shell and widgets running on sample data, no sign-up required.
- [Widget library](https://youinc.net/widgets): Every YouInc dashboard widget, rendered live on sample data.
- [Integrations](https://youinc.net/integrations): How YouInc connects to Akahu, supported banks, manual accounts, and exports.
- [Use cases](https://youinc.net/use-cases): Example ways people can use YouInc for net worth, runway, cashflow, and manual accounts.
- [Compare](https://youinc.net/compare): How YouInc compares with budgeting apps, spreadsheets, personal finance apps, and accounting tools.

## Running it yourself

- [Setup guide](https://github.com/Slaymish/YouInc#run-it-yourself): How to stand up your own instance and connect your own Akahu account.
